data.desc:
{#FF5F1F}(**This mod has two versions - 64bit and 32bit version
Clicking on big button on the right downloads 64bit by default, this version will crash if you switched to Legacy branch on Steam
In that case, you need to download 32bit. Click on Downloads tab and download it there
Please note that 32bit version has no auto updates, therefore you need to reinstall EHI to keep receiving updates and fixes if you switch back to 64bit version (Diesel 3.0)
Your settings will be kept intact**)

Do you want to just see codes and other info ? Download **Codes and Info** standalone [here](https://modworkshop.net/mod/59204).

**Please do not run both EHI and standalone versions at the same time.
Mods share the same codebase and game may crash.
Tracking elements in standalone versions is already included in EHI.**

**Minimum game version required: 1.0.0-158409 (Update 247)
Minimum SuperBLT version required: v1.5.0 (Lua) and [4.0.1-beta](https://modworkshop.net/mod/58342) (DLL)
Minimum EHI version to sync data to other EHI players: r427**
**!!! Failing to meet the minimum requirements will cause crashes in-game !!!**

Shows trackers for various heist related gameplay elements
- Waiting for a van/heli/boat
- Waiting for a C4
- Waiting for a thermite to finish
- Achievements*
- Achievements with progress (e.g.: "Another Way Out" achievement in Hell's Island)
- A chance for something to happen (e.g.: teargas, cooking chance)
- Mission XP Overview
- Buffs (skill or perk) and color them based on their action in-game
- Filter achievements tracked in EHI or for **The Secret** -> See progress filter in Achievements Page
- Damage hit markers or Floating health bars
- Hudlist
- etc...

See screenshots in the "Images" tab for more info and how it looks in-game.

EHI is using in-game panels and should be compatible with all HUD mods.
You can change x, y position in options to move it on the screen. The mod supports Ultra-Wide monitors.

**Accuracy**
Always accurate on host.
Clients should stay accurate within 1-3s range. It is recommended to install (on both host and client side players) [Slowmotion Manager](https://modworkshop.net/mod/18128) mod and remove all slowmotion effects that slows down time calculation.
Desync can also disallow some trackers to show up/update. There is nothing to prevent it.
If you drop-in to a heist, some trackers related to elements may not appear. This is because they are not synced when you drop-in. It can be improved, but it is unfixable.

**Trackers**
Some trackers are inaccurate and have orange color. These trackers can prematurely expire or expire late when an element (van, heli, ...) is interactable.

**Supported heists**
All vanilla heists are supported (Under the Hammer Heist (Update 248) is the latest vanilla heist). Custom heists are not supported due to I have to look into the map scripts and find elements that can be tracked. However, support for them may come at later date.

data.name: Perfect View Laser
data.desc:
# Perfect View Laser

Perfect View Laser is based on the laser behavior of **Less Inaccurate Weapon Laser (LIWL) by TdlQ** and was created to provide precise, weapon-specific laser alignment.

LIWL greatly improves weapon laser accuracy, but due to differences in weapon models, viewmodel positioning, and laser attachment positions, some weapons can still have lasers that are slightly misaligned.

Perfect View Laser was created to compensate for these remaining inaccuracies by allowing you to manually fine-tune the laser direction for each weapon using **Yaw, Pitch, and Roll**.

Each adjustment is saved separately for that weapon, so once you correct a misaligned laser, the correction will automatically be applied whenever you use that weapon again.

## Features

- Includes the improved laser behavior from Less Inaccurate Weapon Laser
- Fine-tune laser direction using Yaw, Pitch, and Roll
- Individual laser corrections for each weapon
- Automatically saves and loads weapon-specific corrections
- Reset the current weapon's laser rotation to its default state
- In-game configuration menu
- Configurable menu keybind
- Supports the SuperBLT Mod Keybind system

## Usage

1. Enter a heist and equip the weapon you want to adjust.
2. If necessary, use **Perfect Viewmodel (PVM)** to correct the weapon's viewmodel rotation first.
3. Open the Perfect View Laser menu using the assigned key.
4. Adjust **Yaw**, **Pitch**, and **Roll** under **Laser Rotation** until the laser is properly aligned.
5. The correction is automatically saved for the currently equipped weapon.
6. Use **Reset** to remove the correction and return that weapon's laser rotation to its default state.

The menu key can also be changed through SuperBLT's Mod Keybinds menu.

## Perfect Viewmodel

For some weapons, adjusting the laser direction alone may not be enough to achieve perfect alignment.

This can happen when the weapon itself uses different viewmodel rotations depending on the player's stance.

The **Campbell 74** is one example. By default, PAYDAY 2 uses different **Yaw, Pitch, and Roll** values for the Campbell 74 when aiming down sights, standing, and crouching. Because of this, a single laser correction may not perfectly align the laser in every stance.

For weapons like this, you may need to use **Perfect Viewmodel (PVM)** first to correct the weapon's rotation between different stances, and then use **Perfect View Laser** to fine-tune the laser itself.

In other words:

**Perfect Viewmodel → correct the weapon's rotation**

**Perfect View Laser → fine-tune the laser**

Using both makes it possible to correct inconsistencies in the weapon's viewmodel rotation first and then precisely align the laser.

Perfect Viewmodel is **not required** to use Perfect View Laser. It is only recommended for weapons that require additional viewmodel rotation adjustments.

## Compatibility

Perfect View Laser incorporates modified code from **Less Inaccurate Weapon Laser**.

You do **not** need to install LIWL separately.

Do not use LIWL and Perfect View Laser at the same time, as both modify the same weapon laser functionality.

Perfect Viewmodel can be used alongside Perfect View Laser and is recommended for weapons that require additional viewmodel rotation adjustments.

## Requirements

- SuperBLT
- BeardLib

## Installation

Extract the **Perfect View Laser** folder into:

`PAYDAY 2/mods/`

## Credits

### TdlQ — Less Inaccurate Weapon Laser

Perfect View Laser is based on LIWL and uses modified LIWL code for its laser raycast and positioning behavior.

Original mod:

http://pd2mods.z77.fr/less_inaccurate_weapon_laser.html

### Luffy — Perfect Viewmodel

Perfect Viewmodel can be used alongside Perfect View Laser to correct weapon viewmodel rotation before fine-tuning the laser.

The in-game configuration menu and UI design of Perfect View Laser were also inspired by Perfect Viewmodel.

Perfect Viewmodel:

https://modworkshop.net/mod/17618

data.name: Milk NIKKE Battle Announcer
data.desc:
Have you ever met someone that for whatever reason always wanted to get in a fight or start a fight? If so, I'm willing to bet that they weren't a girl. Milk however is one. Completing the trifecta of Cafe Sweety (or the Scavengers), she's the one that'll try to convince you that Milk coffee is the best. Now, unlike Sugar and Frima where overdosing on sugar or coffee creamer may ruin your health, a bunch of milk mixed with coffee won't kill you (probably). Outside of the coffee business, she likes to spar a lot. In fact so much so, that she's willing to smack anyone who says that her coffee is the worst within earshot. Now I'm left wondering if her milkshakes bring the boys to the yard. She has 19 voicelines she can say, each having an equal chance of being played. Specifically,

-----
When an enemy is killed (10 sec cooldown):
"All right, let's do this!"
"You're not going anywhere, you twerps!"
"(No...) you're dead meat!"
"Time to turn it up to 11!"
"C'mon, give me all you've got!" 
"Nice!"
"Hah hah!"
"I almost feel sorry for you... but not quite!" 
"Right now!"
"Try this one on for size!"
"Go back to hell where you belong!"
"Ha-ha, leave the fighting to me. I'll show them what for!"
"Alright, who wants some of this?!"
"I'm ready to rock!"

-----
When a heist ends in success:
"Another victory for us, thanks to me!"
"If anyone is giving you a hard time, just let me know and I'll set them straight."
"If you're the one drinking it, then the milk coffee is on me."
"I want to know everything about you, no matter how trivial it is."

-----
When a heist ends in failure:
"I didn't lose! This is a tactical withdrawal."

-----
In game demo: ![](https://youtu.be/3PC7mVicttY)

Fail line (short): ![](https://youtu.be/2LdSYEYgINE)

data.name: Proving Grounds
data.desc:
While the original Enemy Spawner was a handy utility for many people, over time it has grown outdated and hard to work on. Proving Grounds was created to bring the map more features to help more players!

# **Returning Features**
* You can spawn enemies! Didn't expect that, huh?
* They don't shoot you! Wow!
* The buttons are labeled and make a sound when you press them. How useful!
* Don't want to waste bullets killing the enemies? Just hit the "clear enemies" button and they're gone!
* Toggleable greenscreen! This is by far the best in-game greenscreen you'll find in any heist/mod out right now.

# **What's New!**
* Choose enemy faction for the spawner! Привет! Braaaaaaiiiiinnnnss! Hello(But in Murkywaterese)! ¡Hola!
* An arena to fight police assaults! One hundred and seven men enter, one man leaves!
* A shooting range! I've given up with extra flavour texts!
* A bag showcase!
* A weapon showcase!
* Fun little games and easter eggs for you to discover!
* And more!

# **Installation**
1. Install [Beardlib](https://modworkshop.net/mod/14924). Make sure you have the latest version!
2. Create the maps folder in your PAYDAY 2 Install directory if it does not already exist
3. Download the mod, extract the 'Proving Grounds' folder in the contained .zip archive and place said folder within the maps folder.

data.name: Interaction Animations
data.desc:
# Interaction Animations
A **WIP** mod/framework that adds Payday 3-style animations to its prequel.

This version currently supports offhand and dual-arm animations. For now, it's got:
- Keycard insertion
- Grabbing loose loot
- Fixing drills
- Answering pagers
- Lockpicking
- Pressing buttons
- *Other miscellaneous animations*

Both the keycard insertion and the radio answering animations were made by PlayBONK (they're the best animations in the pack, so give lots of praise to her!)

To control what animations are enabled, head over to the mod's option menu. The animation IDs should be self-explanatory towards their deactivation.

# Animator Template
For other animators looking to add onto this framework, [here](https://github.com/Javgarag/pd2-interaction-animations/tree/main/template) is a handy template with everything that needs to be done to add an animation explained thoroughly. Read the `animator_docs.md` file to get started. Feel free to publish a standalone mod with your animation using the template, though you're more than welcome to make additions to this base mod as well (make a pull request on the repo).

Mods that use this framework:
- [Pat Jokers](https://modworkshop.net/mod/59766) by Hoppip

data.name: Rob-erts
data.desc:
# Rob-erts

A remaster of the original GO Bank heist. A small suburban bank with almost no security, but the café next door keeps it full of customers all day. The cash was delivered just recently, so the vault is stuffed.

## Plan A
Find the keycards, wait for the time lock to open, answer the phone call and be ready for what follows. Then find the vault code before the alarm goes off, throw the bags over the fence and escape in the van.

## Plan B
Open the vault without tripping the alarm, move the bags to another spot and escape through the sewers. If the alarm goes off before the vault is open, Plan B is no longer possible.

## Features
- Reworked bank layout, a livelier and more traversable map, a local café
- New random events: the phone call may bring lawyers or an accountant, the roof may be flooded with workers on it, the roof door may be locked
- Random keycard locations: the first can be in the bank safe or on a smoking man behind the café, the second at the teller desk, on the drive-through employee or on the manager
- Pedestrians walking around town. Scare one while wearing a mask and the panic spreads
- Plan B with a sewer escape
- Russian and English localization

Event chances and timers depend on the difficulty. The full tables are on GitHub: https://github.com/g0odhamq-cell/Rob-erts.git

## Requirements
- SuperBLT
- BeardLib 
- Every player in the lobby needs the mod installed

## Installation
Extract the folder into your `Maps` directory.

## Feedback
This is my first released heist, so bug reports and feedback are very welcome. Please include the difficulty, number of players and what happened (the BLT log helps a lot). Report issues here in the comments or on GitHub: https://github.com/g0odhamq-cell/Rob-erts.git

## Changelog
v1.0 - first release

## Credits
Original heist by Overkill Software. Remaster by Rivera.


# Rob-erts

Ремастер оригинального ограбления GO Bank. Небольшой пригородный банк почти без охраны, но благодаря соседнему кафе здесь весь день полно посетителей. Наличные завезли совсем недавно, так что хранилище забито до отказа.

## План «А»
Найдите ключ-карты, дождитесь окончания временного замка, ответьте на звонок и будьте готовы к тому, что последует. Затем найдите код от хранилища, пока не сработала тревога, перебросьте сумки через забор и уезжайте на фургоне.

## План «Б»
Вскройте хранилище, не поднимая тревоги, перенесите сумки в другое место и скройтесь через канализацию. Если тревога сработает до вскрытия хранилища, план «Б» станет невозможен.

## Особенности
- Перепланировка банка, более оживлённая и проходимая карта, местное кафе
- Новые случайные события: после звонка могут приехать юристы или бухгалтер, крыша может оказаться затопленной (на ней будут рабочие), дверь на крышу может быть закрыта
- Случайное расположение ключ-карт: первая может быть в сейфе банка или у курящего мужчины за кафе, вторая на столе за кассой, у сотрудницы у окна обслуживания автомобилей или у менеджера
- Прохожие на улицах. Испугайте одного в маске, и паника может распространиться
- План «Б» с отходом через канализацию
- Локализация на русский и английский языки

Шансы событий и таймеры зависят от сложности. Полные таблицы на GitHub: https://github.com/g0odhamq-cell/Rob-erts.git

## Требования
- SuperBLT
- BeardLib
- Мод должен быть установлен у всех игроков в лобби

## Установка
Распакуйте папку в директорию `Maps`.

## Обратная связь
Это моё первое опубликованное ограбление, поэтому буду очень признателен за сообщения об ошибках и отзывы. Указывайте, пожалуйста, уровень сложности, количество игроков и подробности случившегося (лог BLT очень поможет). data.name: Claire Redfield DLC - Resident Evil
data.desc:
# ***📖 About Claire Redfield***
**Claire had been tracking an organization involved in the illegal trade of biological weapons. Unfortunately, the people behind it were out of reach through official channels.**

**When she discovered that the Payday Gang was planning a job against one of their associates, Claire decided to use the opportunity to get closer to them.**

**Rather than stopping the gang, she offered them a deal — she would help with the heist in exchange for the information she needed.**

**With Clover stepping away from the gang, Claire took her place. What started as a single job quickly became something more.**

🗣️ Dialogue Sources
The dialogues are taken from:
- Resident Evil 2 Remake
- Dead by Daylight
- Resident Evil - Infinite Darkness Series
- Resident Evil - Death Island Movie

data.name: Worthwhile Gage Packages
data.desc:
Tired of having the same couple weapon parts pile up as you keep collecting more of those packages Gage left for us to find? 
Looking to passively build up a good stock of all weapon parts?

Worthwhile Gage Packages randomises which parts are earned from completing a set of Gage's packages. The more packages needed to complete a set the more parts you get.

Green Mantis → 2 weapon mods
Yellow Bull → 4 weapon mods
Red Spider → 6 weapon mods
Blue Eagle → 8 weapon mods
Purple Snake → 10 weapon mods
